liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review, 1 other source): The Crazy Fingers performance out of space is greatly superior to the only other time played; Crazy Fingers and Comes a Time are especially good, with reference quality versions of many songs [1][12]
- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): Hell In A Bucket is jacked up from the first note, starting the party in full force [20]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): The first set closer is superb and sets up an amazing second set [10]
- Garcia is on point on his ballads, making the entire show real nice and tasty [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-07-08.134871.bltz.flac2496** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 155 min [1]
- **gd1987-07-08.nak300.koucky.ladner.35399.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 149 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Beautiful AUD recording with just the right amount of crowd noise to evoke the live experience [10]
- **gd1987-07-08.sbd.miller.90146.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 150 min; rated 3.5/5 by 16 [3]. Said about its sound: The Healy mix sounds more like an audience recording, though it is a great one [18]
- **gd1987-07-08.164877.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1987-07-08.nak300.cohen.105726.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 150 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: A nice clean audience tape from a solid show during what is considered a weak year [17]

## Around the show

- The town was unprepared for the masses but handled the crowd well, similar to Hampton [13]
- The band was happy to be there with Jerry healthy, stretching their arms and having fun [13]
- The crowd went absolutely nuts in the second set, creating an exciting atmosphere to hear [16]
- Tickets were hard to come by for this small venue stop in a summer of huge stadium shows [21]
- The uploader did not attend but considers it one of the best shows they have seen [6]
- Considered one of the best shows seen, with a superior version of the rare combo [12]
- Shows taken during breaks from the Dylan tour were usually something special, like this one [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-07-08.134871.bltz.flac2496**: taped by bltz; transferred by bltz; source: Source: Nakamichi CM-300s/2-Mic CP-4 super-directional shotgun capsule -> Sony Walkman Pro/Maxell XLII-S 90 -> JVC TD-W354 -> Zoom H6 96/24 WAV -> Audacity ->… [1]
- **gd1987-07-08.nak300.koucky.ladner.35399.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bill Koucky; transferred by Chris Ladner; source: Taper's section at the SBD, Nakamichi 300s > Sony D5 > Maxell MX90 Master Cassettes [2]
- **gd1987-07-08.sbd.miller.90146.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat -> FLAC [3]
- **gd1987-07-08.164877.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME80 mics > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd1987-07-08.nak300.cohen.105726.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Dave Cohen; transferred by Dave Cohen; source: 2 Nakamichi CM100s/CP4>Sony TCD5M w/Dolby Maxell MX90s cassettes. 5th row behind Board, DFC (Sec LT5 Row E Seat 5) [8]

FLAC'd using Audiofile Engineering Sample Manager.
